Commentary.Commentary: Right then, we have our semi-finals line-up ready! It will be Zimbabwe going up against Papua New Guinea in the first semi-final at this same venue Queens Sports Club, Bulawayo. The second semi-final will see the Netherlands going head-to-head against the USA at Bulawayo Athletic Club. Both the games will start at 5 pm IST (11.30 am GMT). So, do join us for the coverage. Remember, the two teams who will come out on top in these games will book their ticket for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup to be held in Australia later this year. Cheers!
Sikandar Raza has been named MAN OF THE MATCH FOR HIS BRILLIANT KNOCK! It is his knock which took the game away from USA and he truly deserves this award.

The Zimbabwe bowling came to life after the first 5. Their bowlers really took a pounding before that but once they got the opening wicket, they not only managed to apply the squeeze but also managed to take wickets. Wellington Masakadza was the pick for Zimbabwe but overall, it was a complete performance from them. USA bowled well in the first half in patches but their death bowling really cost them and they need to come out with better plans and execution in the big semi-final that is coming their way.

Quite a convincing win in the end for the hosts! That innings from Sikandar Raza was the difference. Above 180 was always going to be a huge task and they have fallen well short of it. They though got off to to a very good start courtesy their openers. Once that partnership was broken, it all went downward for them. They kept losing wickets in the attempt to fine the boundary and in the end, they have lost by quite a big margin.

So just a single to end the game! It has been a comfortable win for Zimbabwe! A yorker again on middle. Saurabh Netravalkar manages to dig it out towards the leg side for a single. Zimbabwe win by 46 runs!
Almost in the blockhole again on middle. Patel digs it out to long on for a single.
Nails a yorker, around leg. Patel looks to dig it out but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Saurabh Netravalkar dabs it towards backward point for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Patel works it to the leg side for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Luke Jongwe gets a wicket now and eight down now USA! A low full toss on middle. Cameron Stevenson looks to power it away. He, however, gets the bottom of his blade and only manages to hit it wide of extra cover. Craig Ervine runs to his right and takes a fine catch. Saurabh Netravalkar is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: Luke Jongwe to bowl the last over.
Bangs it short on middle, angling in. Cameron Stevenson pulls it awkwardly through square leg for a single.
Goes back of a length again, outside off, Nisarg Patel punches it off his back foot past point for a run.
Fuller and outside off, Cameron Stevenson uses his feet and works it to long off for a run.
On a length and on leg, Nisarg Patel pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Nice Shot. This is back of a length on middle and leg, Nisarg Patel clears his back leg and smears it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Serves it full, angling in. Cameron Stevenson goes for the drive but gets an inside edge towards square leg for one.
On middle and fuller. Patel sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
WIDE! Shorter and wider outside off. Patel looks to get a bat on it but misses.
SIX! Over the fence this time! Tossed up on off. Patel gets under it and tonks it straight down the ground for a maximum.
This is fuller and outside off. It turns away sharply and beats Patel as he looks to cut it.

In the air...but safe! Tossed up, outside off. Patel looks to go big downtown. However, he gets a top edge that falls just away from the fielder at extra-cover who paddles back to catch it. Couple of runs taken.
Shorter and flatter outside off. Cameron Stevenson looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge to short third man. A single taken.
Tossed up, around off. Cameron Stevenson drives it to mid off for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
Full and on off, Cameron Stevenson works it on the off side for one.
Cameron Stevenson walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wellington Masakadza has his fourth wicket of the match. This is on the shorter side on middle, Marty Kain goes on his back foot and goes for the pull, but he could not apply much power and hits it straight into the hands of Ryan Burl at deep square leg.
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Burl b Wellington Masakadza

Commentary.Commentary: Floated on off, Nisarg Patel steps out and works it throug mid off for a run.
Tossed up on off, Marty Kain reverse-sweeps it to point for one.
Floated on off, played through covers for a single.
Slower through the air and outside off. Patel drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Patel works it towards the leg side.
Tossed up on middle. Patel sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Pushed quicker on off. Kain punches it to covers for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Patel drives it to long off for a single.
Nisarg Patel walks in next.

OUT! BOWLED! Another one bites the dust! This is tossed up, googly, around off. Sushant Modani looks to sweep it away. However, he only manages to get the inside edge of his blade and the ball goes onto shatter the stumps. USA started off positively but are falling apart now.
Good length on the fifth stump line, Sushant Modani slices it past point for another single. The singles won't do for USA now, they need boundaries.
On a length and on off, Marty Kain pushes it through covers for a run.
Slower ball again, back of a length, outside off. Sushant Modani opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for one.
Bowls a cutter on a length, outside off. Sushant Modani mistimes his shot back to the bowler.
Full again on middle, Marty Kain flicks it off his pads to square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, Sushant Modani drives it firmly past extra covers for a single.
Luke Jongwe is into the attack now.
Tossed up, around off. Sushant Modani drives it to long off for a single. 86 needed now from 36 balls!
A googly and outside off. Kain makes room and squeezes it to backward point for a single.
On the shorter side on off. Kain pulls it wide of long on for a couple.
This is fuller and tossed up, outside off. Kain looks to drive it away but misses.
This is fuller on off. Kain drives it to mid off.
Pushed quicker around off. Kain pushes it to covers for a single.
A tossed up delivery on off. Kain hits it firmly to long off for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Sushant Modani pushes it to long on for a single.
On middle and fuller. Kain works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Pulls the length back on leg. Marty Kain looks to pull it but misses and gets hit on his body.
Sushant Modani is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Third wicket for Wellington Masakadza and USA sink further! Tossed up, around off. Singh goes for a big sweep but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air towards deep backward square leg and Ryan Burl there takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Ryan Burl b Wellington Masakadza

Commentary.Commentary: A flatter delivery on middle, slightly shorter in length. Gajanand Singh works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Shortish and outside off, Gajanand Singh guides it past covers for a single.
Full and on off, Marty Kain knocks it towards long off for one.
A bit short on off, Gajanand Singh punches it through covers for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
Floated on leg, Marty Kain flicks it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! UNORTHODOX! This flatter and quciker on middle, Marty Kain goes down and plays the reverse-sweep past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
On the shorter side on off. Kain punches it to long off for a single.
Goes fuller, around off. Kain pushes it to covers.
Marty Kain is the next man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Wellington Masakadza gets his second wicket in the over and Zimbabwe are right on top now. This is pushed quicker and flatter on off. Jaskaran Malhotra backs away a bit and looks to cut it. However, he misses it completely and the ball shatters the stumps.  USA are losing their way in these middle overs.
On the shorter side on off. Jaskaran Malhotra blocks it out.
Gajanand Singh is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another catch from Milton Shumba and this is a big wicket of Steven Taylor! Wellington Masakadza bowls it fuller on off. It surely is in the slot to hit. Steven Taylor goes for a big shot down the ground. However, he does not get the required power behind this shot and ends up hitting it aerially towards long off. Milton Shumba runs to left and takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Wellington Masakadza

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and around off. Jaskaran Malhotra pulls it wide of long on for a single.
BEATEN! Tossed up on off, drifting away. Steven Taylor goes for the cut but gets beaten by the slight turn and the ball just goes past his outside edge.
Slower through the air, turning away. Steven Taylor lets it go. Wided.
Floated on middle and leg, this is flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Full toss on middle, Steven Taylor works it through covers for another single.
A leggie from Raza. This is short on middle, Jaskaran Malhotra pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A bit short on middle, Steven Taylor punches it of his back foot past point for a run.
Tossed up on off, Jaskaran Malhotra lofts it towards long off for a single.
A flatter one on off. Jaskaran Malhotra works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Who will be the next batter in?

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch by Milton Shumba! This is tossed up on middle. Jones looks to go big downtown. However, he gets a bottom of his blade and the ball goes aerailly towards long off. Milton Shumba runs forward from the deep and dives forward to take a brilliant catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Sean Williams

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely played! A fuller delivery on middle. Jones reverse-sweeps it past short third-man for a boundary.
A flatter one on middle. Jones blocks it out.
Pushed fuller on off. Taylor drives it to covers for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Taylor looks to sweep it but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards short fine leg. Two leg byes taken.
On middle, blocked out.
On the shorter side this time, on middle and leg. Steven Taylor flicks it off his back foot through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, Jones pushes it through covers for a run.
Shorter and around off. Taylor punches it to covers for a single.
This is fuller and outside off. Jones drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Taylor drills it to long on for a single.
Sikandar Raza is back on.
Two dots to end! Flatter and on off, Jones guides it to point. A tidy start by Williams.
On off, Jones pushes it to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is chopped through covers for one more.
Two! Good running! On middle, this is nudged through mid-wicket for a couple.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A single now! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Sean Williams comes into the attack now.

A dot to end the Powerplay and it has been an action-packed one. Have to say, USA will be the happier of the two sides. They are 55 for 1 after it. The last ball is on a length and aroud off, defended.
Aaron Jones walks out at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! That is the wicket Zimbabwe needed! Patel falls prey to the short ball! On the shorter side and on the body. Patel looks to pull, this goes off the splice, it lobs to the man at mid on where it is taken by Sean Williams comfortably. A really good delivery. Cramped the batter for room.
Commentary.Howout: c Sean Williams b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Taylor misses out there! On the pads, a full toss, Taylor swings, it goes more off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
Direct hit but the batter is well in! On off, this is pushed to mid on. They go for one, the fielder hits the stumps at the bowler's end but the batter is well in.
Another single as this is guided down to third man.
On off, Patel strokes it to mid off for one.
WIDE! Patel shuffles across. This is bowled short and down the leg side. Patel looks to pull but misses. Wided.
FOUR! Fifty up and in no time! Length and outside off, this is smashed through cover for a boundary. USA are on course to chase it down.
Just over again! A slower one on middle, Taylor lofts it down the ground, not off the middle but hit well enough to clear mid on for two more.
Just over! Length and outside off, Taylor comes down the track and swings but it goes off the outer half over cover for two.
A really good slower one, outside off, Taylor looks to go downtown but misses.
A loud appeal but turned down! Angled into the pads, Patel looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. A leg bye taken. Going down leg.
Short and angling into the body, Patel looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Change of ends for Blessing Muzarabani now. Zimbabwe need their strike bowler to deliver here!
A single to end yet another really good over for USA! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries at the moment! Short and on the body, this is pulled over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
On off, defended.
FOUR! EDGY! Length and around off, Patel slashes, it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
FOUR! Up and over! Length and on middle, Patel takes a few steps down the track and whacks it over the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Good length and on off, Patel pushes it to mid off.
Change of ends for Richard Ngarava.
FOUR! Taylor is looking in the mood today. Tossed up again on middle, Steven Taylor smashes it towards the fine leg fence for another boundary. 13 runs from the over.
SIX! Bang! Tossed up on middle and leg, Steven Taylor slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full and outside off, Patel pushes it through covers for one.
Short again on off, Patel smashes it hard but staright to extra covers.
A bit short and outside off, Steven Taylor punches it of his back foot to extra covers for a run.
Starts with a floated delivery outside off, Patel drives it through covers for a run.
Sikandar Raza is into the attack now.
A dot to end! On off, defended.
Back of a length and on middle, defended.
FOUR! Hammered! Stand and delver! Taylor is in the mood here! This is on a length and outside off, he smacks it over cover for another boundary. Second in the over.
Goes back to bowling it on a length and just outside off. Taylor mistimes it to cover.
FOUR! Put away with disdain! Slightly short and the length is picked early. Taylor smacks it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
BEATEN! Looks to drive on the up to this ball which is slanting away from the off pole. Not easy to hit Blessing Muzarabani like that. He gets some extra bounce because of his height.
Blessing Muzarabani to start from the other end.
Oh! That was close. Richard Ngarava bowls it on a length outside off, nipping back in of the surface. Monank Patel throws his bat at it but gets beaten on his inside edge.
On a length and on middle and leg, Steven Taylor flicks it throug mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Steven Taylor punches it of his back foot past point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time. Bowls it short again outside off, Steven Taylor cuts it past point and wide of third man for a boundary. Zimbabwe and Steven Taylor are off the mark.
Short and outside off, Steven Taylor cuts it but straight to short extra cover.
Serves a good-length delivery, outside off. Steven Taylor leaves it alone.
